name: Cloudways AI Website Builder
tagline: AI builder that generates WordPress and WooCommerce sites from a text prompt and hosts them on Cloudways servers.
bestFor: WordPress users and agencies who want AI-built sites on managed hosting
description: Cloudways AI Website Builder turns a text prompt into a WordPress or WooCommerce site built from native Gutenberg blocks. You refine it by AI chat, a visual editor or a code editor, and it runs on a Cloudways managed server. The builder is billed per website, and hosting is billed separately.
pros: Sites are standard WordPress with Gutenberg blocks and full WordPress admin access, so they are not locked to the builder
Per-site price drops from $7.99 to $5.99/mo at 21 or more sites
Edits in the visual and code editors, and chat questions, use no AI credits
5-day free trial with no credit card
cons: Hosting is billed separately from $11/mo, so one site costs at least $18.99/mo at regular prices
Only 20 AI credits per site per month, and they do not roll over
No free domain; you connect a domain you own
trial: 5-day free trial on a trial server, no credit card

plans.name: 1-5 websites
plans.notes: Per website per month, plus hosting (Managed Hosting from $11/mo: 1 GB RAM, 1 vCPU, 25 GB SSD, 1 TB transfer, unlimited sites per server). 20 AI credits per site per month, no rollover; one-time top-up packs of 20 to 200 credits. No annual billing listed. Black Friday offer to Dec 4-5, 2026: 80% off for 2 months ($1.60/site/mo), then $7.99.

plans.name: 6-20 websites
plans.notes: Per website per month, plus hosting. Same credits and features. Black Friday price $1.40/site/mo for 2 months.

plans.name: 21+ websites
plans.notes: Per website per month, plus hosting. Same credits and features. Black Friday price $1.20/site/mo for 2 months.

integrations: WordPress, WooCommerce, Cloudflare, DNS Made Easy

sources.label: cloudways.com: AI Website Builder general availability
DigitalOcean: Cloudways launches AI Website Builder

launch.what: Cloudways launched its AI Website Builder after a public preview, with paid per-site pricing from $7.99 a month.

name: Bluehost AI Builder
tagline: Bluehost's prompt-based builder for websites and simple business apps, with a free tier on a Bluehost subdomain.
bestFor: Small businesses that want a site with bookings, forms or a customer portal built by chat
description: Bluehost AI Builder creates websites and web apps from a plain-language description and hosts them on Bluehost's cloud. It can add bookings, forms, databases, invoices and user accounts. Plans are priced by monthly AI credits; hosting does not use credits.
pros: Free tier with no end date and no credit card, with unlimited sites and apps
Bookings, forms, data storage, user accounts and an admin panel on every plan
A published site stays online when credits run out; only new changes pause
24/7 human support on every plan, including Free
cons: Free sites use a .app.bluehost.ai address that search engines do not index, and a custom domain needs a paid plan
Credits expire after 30 days, including purchased top-ups
No free domain; domain registration is billed separately
The pricing page shows only yearly prices, and the Pro plan has no listed price
freePlanDetails: 5 AI credits a day, up to 30 a month; unlimited sites and apps; publishes on a bluehost.ai subdomain with a Bluehost badge; no custom domain.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 5 credits a day, up to 30 a month. Forms, bookings, user accounts and roles, admin panel, cloud hosting on a bluehost.ai subdomain.

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: 100 credits a month, no daily limit, credit top-ups, custom domain, no Bluehost badge. Page shows '$16.00/mo' and 'Billed Yearly at $240.00' ($240 / 12 = $20); the FAQ says paid plans start at $20 a month. $16 appears to reflect a first-term 'Buy More, Save More' discount running Oct 1 to Nov 30, 2026. Month-to-month price not shown.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: 200 credits a month plus everything in Lite. Page shows '$32.00/mo' and billed yearly at $480.00 ($480 / 12 = $40). Month-to-month price not shown.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 400 credits a month per Bluehost's help article. No price is shown on the pricing page.

integrations: Google Calendar (bookings), email notifications, domain purchase and transfer

sources.label: bluehost.com: AI Website Builder pricing and FAQ
bluehost.com: How to start a Builder plan
PR Newswire: Bluehost launches AI Builder

launch.what: Bluehost launched AI Builder at its ELEVATE small business summit, with a free tier and credit-based paid plans.

name: Ploy
tagline: AI platform that builds and hosts a company website, then runs SEO pages, visitor tracking and ads from it.
bestFor: B2B startups that want the website and its marketing run by AI agents
description: Ploy builds company websites with an AI builder, hosts them on a custom domain and adds a CMS called PloyDB. It also identifies site visitors, creates landing pages for SEO and account-based campaigns, and manages Meta ads. It was founded by Webflow co-founder Bryant Chou.
pros: Free plan with no credit card
Hosting is included on every plan
Imports sites from WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, Framer, Wix and Sanity
Annual billing cuts Starter from $50 to $40/mo
cons: Paid plans start at $50/mo, well above general website builders
Free plan has no custom domain and a 2,000-credit cap
freePlanDetails: 500 credits a day, 2,000 maximum; hosting included; no custom domain, collaborators or CRM and ad integrations.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 500 credits a day (2,000 max). GitHub sync via CLI only. No custom domain.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 4,000 credits a month, 1 domain family, 50 enriched visitors a month, Google Workspace and GitHub sync. Annual billed $480/yr.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 24,000 credits a month, 5 domain families, 1,000 enriched visitors a month, ad integrations, HubSpot and Attio. Annual billed $2,880/yr.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom credits and pricing, Salesforce, SSO, role-based access, white-glove onboarding.

integrations: HubSpot, Attio, Salesforce (Enterprise), Google Workspace, GitHub, Meta Ads, Notion import, Slack, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor

sources.label: Pulse 2.0: Ploy raises $27 million seed round

launch.what: Ploy came out of stealth as generally available with a $27 million seed round led by First Round Capital and Y Combinator.

name: Figma Sites
tagline: Figma's tool for designing responsive websites on the Figma canvas and publishing them directly.
bestFor: Designers who already work in Figma and want to publish their designs as live sites
description: Figma Sites turns Figma designs into responsive websites and publishes them on a figma.site subdomain or a custom domain. It includes templates, prebuilt blocks, interaction presets, a CMS and AI-generated code for custom interactions. It is in open beta and is included with paid Figma Full seats.
pros: Uses existing Figma designs, libraries and components
No limit on the number of published sites
CMS lets collaborators edit content without changing the layout
Password protection for published sites
cons: Still in open beta since May 2025
Priced per Full seat, not per site; publishing needs a paid plan
No code export, and no built-in store or memberships
trial: Figma Starter is free, but Figma's help pages say publishing a site needs a paid plan

plans.name: Professional (Full seat)
plans.notes: Per Full seat per month as shown on figma.com/pricing. The page has a monthly/annual toggle but the fetched view showed one price; third-party guides report $20 billed monthly, not confirmed on Figma's page. Up to 10 custom domains. 3,000 AI credits a month per Full seat (Figma-wide, not Sites-specific).

plans.name: Organization (Full seat)
plans.notes: Per Full seat per month, billed annually only. Unlimited custom domains; can restrict sites to an internal audience.

plans.name: Enterprise (Full seat)
plans.notes: Per Full seat per month, billed annually only. Unlimited custom domains; internal-only sites.

integrations: Figma Design libraries and components, Cloudflare (domains and routing)

launch.what: Figma announced Figma Sites at Config 2025 and released it in open beta.

name: Readdy
tagline: AI website builder that generates and hosts a site from a description, with forms, logins and an AI receptionist.
bestFor: Small businesses and agencies that want AI-built sites with lead capture
description: Readdy generates a website from a text description and lets you refine it with visual editing tools. It hosts the site with SSL, connects or sells custom domains, and adds forms, user logins and a built-in database. Agency plans add client management and white-labeling.
pros: Free tier to try the editor, with 250 credits a month
Yearly plans include one free custom domain for the first year
Built-in Shop with checkout and orders; Stripe, PayPal or Square for payments
Adds email sign-up and sign-in pages through Readdy Backend
cons: Free plan cannot publish a site (0 sites included)
Monthly billing costs about two-thirds more than yearly (Starter $25 vs $15 a month)
Extra sites cost $6/mo each on Starter, Pro and Agency
No member-only content or paid memberships; sign-in only
freePlanDetails: 250 credits a month, 2 projects, 200 MB storage; 0 published sites, no code export or custom domain.
trial: Free plan for trying the editor (250 credits a month); publishing a site needs a paid plan

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 250 credits a month, 2 projects, no published site included.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 1 site, 10 projects, 30,000 credits, 1 GB storage, 1 free custom domain, code export, 1,000 leads a month. Yearly view shows $15/mo with $25 struck through (not labeled as the monthly-billing price). 2-year (50% off) and 3-year (60% off) terms offered, prices not shown.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 2 sites, 50 projects, 72,000 credits, 5 GB storage, 1 free custom domain, AEO/GEO, 10,000 leads a month. $40 struck through.

plans.name: Agency
plans.notes: 6 sites, 150 projects, 216,000 credits a year, client management, GitHub, branded email. $120 struck through.

plans.name: Agency Pro
plans.notes: 10 sites, unlimited credits, white-label platform, extra sites $4.80/mo. $199 struck through.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: Unlimited sites, projects and credits. $1,299 struck through. A separate Reseller Mode is quote-only.

integrations: Stripe, Shopify, Calendly, Mailchimp, Google Analytics, Google Sheets, Supabase, GitHub, Resend

launch.what: Readdy launched publicly on Product Hunt as an AI website builder that builds and publishes sites.
